searchText: I think ultimately it will use some sort of FFI to reduce the latency even further; the verifier part of the proof engine should be a lot smaller in size than the prover So no plan to create a "proof engine library with only verification capabilities", that could be used directly in the beacon client binary (as done with the c-kzg lib)? Ah there is a plan, and it would have the same API as the binary I think we don't want to do this now because it would introduce friction and docker containers is easier Nothing particularly wrong with the docker solution imo though
